name: 4-1:The Lost Ruins
short:
Break the
seal to the
ruins and
get inside!
long:
Client: Principal
Quest:
 We believe that we have
 found ruins under the
 surface of Ragol.
 The entrance is sealed,
 however. Please try to
 find a way inside in
 order to investigate.

Yes
No

I've been waiting for
you, <name job> <name hero>.
Let me get to the point:

The passage beyond the
underground monitor room
leads to some ruins.

But there's some sort of
seal, and we can't get
through to investigate.

You've done so much for
us already. But we need
your assistance again.

Find a way to get past
that seal and into those
ruins!

With all our information,
the Lab believes that the
key to unlocking the seal

lies within the monument
on Ragol's surface, the
one down in the caverns,

and the one most recently
found in the mines.

Somehow, those are the
keys to unlock the seal!

As always, Irene can give
you the details.
...I'm counting on you.

Please speak to Irene,
my secretary.

These ruins could be the
cause of all of this...

Maybe the people from
Pioneer 1 are in there.

<name hero>, you
need to find a way to
open that seal!

So, the Lab's hypothesis
that the key to the ruins
was correct.

But, still... I guess I
shouldn't be surprised
by this discovery.

But how can anything be
alive down in these
ancient ruins?!

I may ask you to
investigate this further,
<name hero>.

Know that I'm counting
on you.

Where do you
think you're
going?

You haven't spoken
with Irene for the
details, yet!
Hello again!

Here are the details
for this job.

You are to investigate
and report on the
underground ruins.

The entrance to these
ruins is sealed,
however.

The Lab believes that the
seal can be broken using
the monuments on Ragol.

The most recent one was
located in the mines.

They believe that these
three pillars hold the
key to opening the seal.

Still, I wonder... This
seal might be holding in
something very dangerous.

Anyway, don't let down
your guard and be
careful.
Oh, by the way...

Regarding the Principal's
daughter, Red Ring Rico:

If you hear anything new,
please let me know.
Thank you for doing this.

Rico must have made her
way into those ruins,
too.

Please, you have to
find her!

The Principal is waiting.
Please give him your
report.

Glad to see you back
alive and well.

So, those ruins were 
very ancient, then?

And yet more unseen
enemies to deal with...

Just when are we going to
see the end of this all?

Well, we'll call on you
again when you're needed.

Why don't you go take
a break and relax?

You have already finished
this quest.

Please select "Cancel" at
the Counter to return to
the Lobby.

The mines we discovered
might have been created
just to get to the ruins!

That would also explain
why there's a facility
down there, too!

These underground
ruins...

Some ancient civilization
must have lived here on
Ragol.

But Pioneer 1 reported no
signs of a civilization
on the planet's surface.

This mystery just keeps
getting deeper and more
twisted as we continue.

I've got a tiny
inkling...

About the previous
civilization that lived
beneath Ragol.

Pioneer 1 somehow knew 
that these ancient ruins
underground existed.

And they went to excavate
them for research...

And then something
happened. ...Something!

It seems that you cannot
go any further.
